title: 打扫卫生间比倒垃圾费时，室友怎么轮换家务？
wechat_digest: 打扫卫生间比倒垃圾费时，室友怎么轮换家务？
lead: 示例情境：两位室友每周各做一项家务。米娜打扫卫生间要 30 分钟，萨姆一周倒垃圾共用 10 分钟。他们想试试让每个人在两周内各做一次较费时的活。人物、耗时和分工均为示例。

dialogue.en: Mina: We each have one chore, but cleaning the bathroom takes me half an hour. How long does taking out the trash take you each week?
dialogue.zh: 米娜：我们各做一项家务，但我打扫卫生间要半小时。你每周倒垃圾要多久？

dialogue.en: Sam: I timed it last week. About ten minutes in total.
dialogue.zh: 萨姆：我上周计过时，加起来大概十分钟。

dialogue.en: Mina: So we do an equal number of chores, but we spend different amounts of time on them.
dialogue.zh: 米娜：所以我们做的家务项数一样，花的时间却不一样。

dialogue.en: Sam: What if we divide the work differently and rotate duties every week?
dialogue.zh: 萨姆：要不我们换个分法，每周轮换一次？

dialogue.en: Mina: That works. The bathroom is my responsibility this week. Can you take it next week? I’ll take out the trash.
dialogue.zh: 米娜：可以。这周卫生间归我负责。下周能换你吗？我来倒垃圾。

dialogue.en: Sam: Sure. I’ve put both weeks on the calendar. If each chore takes about the same amount of time as it did last week, we’ll each spend about 40 minutes over two weeks.
dialogue.zh: 萨姆：行。我把这两周的分工记进日历了。如果每项家务耗时和上周差不多，两周下来我们每人总共做大约 40 分钟。

chore.usage: housework 泛指家务劳动。chore 可以指拖地这一件具体的活。
chore.pitfall: chore 可数。说「一项家务」用 a chore，说「做些家务」可以用 do some chores。

divide.usage: divide 强调把整体拆开分配。share 还可以强调共同承担，比如两个人一起打扫厨房。
divide.pitfall: between 引出分给谁。into 引出分成什么，例如 divide the work into two parts。

equal.usage: equal 描述数量相同。fair 评价安排是否公平，例如双方同意这周少做的人下周补上，也可以算公平。
equal.pitfall: equal 是形容词。修饰「分」这个动作时用副词 equally，例如 divide the cost equally。

responsibility.usage: job 可以指眼前要做的一件活。responsibility 强调由谁负责把事情办妥，例如有人帮忙锁门，你仍负责确认门锁好了。
responsibility.pitfall: 说「某人负责做某事」可以用 Someone is responsible for doing something。be 后用形容词 responsible。

rotate.usage: swap 可以只交换一次。rotate 表示按安排反复换人，例如每周一轮。
rotate.pitfall: 说人在两项工作之间轮换时，用 rotate between A and B，例如 We rotate between cleaning the bathroom and taking out the trash。

practice.question: 用 equal 解释旧分工的问题。两人各做一项家务，一人用 30 分钟，另一人用 10 分钟。
practice.answer: We do an equal number of chores, but we spend different amounts of time on them.
practice.explanation: 用 equal 比较项目数量，再指出耗时不同。

practice.question: 用 responsibility 写一句交接的话，说明下周由萨姆负责打扫卫生间。
practice.answer: It’s Sam’s responsibility to clean the bathroom next week.
practice.explanation: 用所有格 Sam’s 交代负责人，to clean 引出具体职责。

practice.question: 新情境：志愿者每周按表换人接待来访者。用 rotate 改写 We take turns greeting visitors every week.
practice.answer: We rotate greeting duties every week.
practice.explanation: rotate 后接要轮换的职责，every week 保留轮换频率。

takeaway_en: Could we rotate duties so we each get a turn at the longer job?
takeaway_zh: 我们能轮换分工，让每个人都轮到较费时的那项活吗？
closing: 写轮换表时，标清每次换人的日期和下一位负责人。
